🚀 How to publish it
Download and extract the ZIP.

Open your sree77rag GitHub repository.

Replace the existing README.md with the included one.

Upload the entire assets folder, preserving the filenames and folder structure.

Commit the changes.

Important: Keep the SVG files inside assets/. The README references them using relative paths, so changing their locations will break the images.

The SVG files have been checked for valid XML. The externally hosted GitHub statistics images depend on their services being available.

You need both the README code and the SVG files to make your GitHub profile look exactly as designed. 🔥

✅ What to upload to GitHub
Your repository should have this structure:

sree77rag/
│
├── README.md
│
└── assets/
    ├── hero.svg
    ├── about.svg
    ├── tech-stack.svg
    └── github-stats.svg
🚀 How to upload everything
Step 1: Upload the README

Open your GitHub profile repository.

Open README.md.

Click the ✏️ Edit button.

Replace the existing code with the contents of the new README.

Commit your changes.

Step 2: Upload the SVG files

Open your repository.

Create a folder named assets.

Upload all four SVG files into that folder.

Keep their filenames unchanged.

⚠️ Important
If you paste only the README code, the custom SVG designs won't appear unless those SVG files are already uploaded to the correct locations.

Easiest option: Download the complete bundle below, extract it, and upload the files while preserving the folder structure.
